components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

Important finding on `telephoneDisplay`: it appears **only in a test** (`AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay`) as an expectation. It does **not** currently exist in the entity, the OpenAPI spec, or any DTO — it is an unimplemented feature the test targets.

## 1. Owner entity and telephone field

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (extends `Person`). Telephone field (lines 50-53), with getter/setter (110-116):

```java
@Column(name = "telephone")
@NotEmpty
@Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message = "Phone number must be in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits")
private String telephone;
```

Note: `getIdentityKey()` (lines 311-315) also composes the telephone into a fingerprint. There is no `telephoneDisplay` getter/field.

## 2. Owner response DTO / mapping

There is **no hand-written response DTO and no static `from` method.** The response DTO is the generated `OwnerDto` (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, generated from `openapi.yml`). Mapping from entity to DTO is via MapStruct:

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — the full contents are shown below (key line: `displayName` is injected via a MapStruct `expression`; all other properties map by name):

```java
@Mapper(uses = PetMapper.class)
public interface OwnerMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "displayName",
        expression = "java(owner.getLastName() + \", \" + owner.getFirstName())")
    OwnerDto toOwnerDto(Owner owner);

    Owner toOwner(OwnerDto ownerDto);

    @Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
    @Mapping(target = "pets", ignore = true)
    Owner toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerDto);

    List<OwnerDto> toOwnerDtoCollection(Collection<Owner> ownerCollection);
    Collection<Owner> toOwners(Collection<OwnerDto> ownerDtos);

    default OwnerPageDto toOwnerPageDto(@NonNull Page<Owner> ownerPage) { ... }
}
```

The DTO is sent to the client in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java`:
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, ObjectResponse<OwnerDto> response) {
    response.send(ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner));
}
```
(Related responders: `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` in the same directory.)

The `Owner` schema (the actual response shape) is defined in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2074-2204. It uses `allOf: OwnerFields` + read-only derived fields (`id`, `displayName`, `initials`, `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount`, `membershipNumber`, `membershipLevel`, `locality`, `bulkSignupWarning`, `ageBand`, `contactPreference`, `identityKey`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, `pets`). There is **no `telephoneDisplay` property** in this schema.

## 3. Request DTOs for owners

The request DTO is the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` (used by `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` in the mapper and by the telephone functions). Its schema is `OwnerFields` in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines ~1995-2073. Properties: `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `postcode`, `registrationDate`, `birthDate`, `sharesHousehold` (writeOnly). Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone.

Telephone in the request schema (lines 2026-2033):
```yaml
telephone:
  title: Telephone number
  description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
  type: string
  minLength: 1
  maxLength: 20
  pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
  example: '+61412345678'
```
(Note the request pattern is permissive `^[-+0-9() ]*$`, distinct from the entity's strict E.164 pattern.)

## 4. Where telephone is validated / normalized

Validation happens at multiple layers:

- **Bean-validation pattern on entity**: `Owner.java` line 52 — strict E.164 `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$`.
- **OpenAPI/generated-DTO bean validation**: `openapi.yml` telephone pattern `^[-+0-9() ]*$`, minLength 1, maxLength 20 (`performBeanValidation` is enabled in the generator config, so this becomes `@Pattern`/`@Size` on `OwnerFieldsDto`).

- **Pipeline length rule** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerTelephoneLength.java`: calls `E164PhoneNumber.hasValidNationalNumberLength(...)`, throws `TelephoneNationalNumberLengthException` (→ 400).
- **Utility** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/E164PhoneNumber.java`: pure Java (regex-based, **no libphonenumber**). Default country code `61` (Australia); strips `[\s()\-]`; drops a single leading `0`; E.164 regex `\+[0-9]{8,15}`; fixed national-number lengths map `{"1":10, "61":9}`. Full logic in `toE164` and `hasValidNationalNumberLength`.

These functions are wired into the flow YAMLs:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (normalizeTelephone → validateTelephoneLength)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/InvalidTelephoneException.java` + `InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler.java` (400, ProblemDetail).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/TelephoneNationalNumberLengthException.java` + `TelephoneNationalNumberLengthExceptionHandler.java` (400).
- Registered via `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/...InvalidTelephoneException.yml` and `...TelephoneNationalNumberLengthException.yml`.

## 5. Tests referencing telephone / telephoneDisplay

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — the only reference to `telephoneDisplay`. Full file (20 lines) sends `telephone = "0412 345 678"`, creates the owner, then asserts `$.telephone == "+61412345678"` and `$.telephoneDisplay == "+61 412 345 678"` (E.164 country code, space, national digits grouped in threes). This feature is not yet implemented anywhere in main.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — helpers `uniqueTelephone()` (returns `"04%08d"` = 10-digit AU mobile), `ownerNode()` (builds a valid payload with telephone), plus `ownerNode`/`createOwnerOk`/`getOwner` used by the test. Comments (lines 98-104) explain the telephone rule chain (+61 => 9 national digits).

No other test files reference telephone.

## 6. Build file — dependencies, phone formatting, Java version

`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml` (Maven; artifactId `spring-petclinic-rest`).

- **Parent**: `spring-boot-starter-parent` version **4.1.0**.
- **Java version**: not explicitly overridden via a `<java.version>` or `<maven.compiler.release>` property in this pom (referenced as `${java.version}`/`${maven.compiler.release}` but inherited from the Spring Boot 4.1.0 parent — i.e. the Boot 4 baseline, Java 17+). There is no explicit Java 21/17 declaration in the file.
- **Phone-number formatting library**: **NONE.** No `libphonenumber`, no `com.google.i18n`, no `PhoneNumberUtil` anywhere in the pom or source. All phone handling is the hand-rolled regex util `E164PhoneNumber`.
- **Key dependencies**: officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter (`officefloor.version` 4.0.2); spring-boot starters: actuator, aspectj, cache, data-jpa, jdbc, webmvc, security, validation; DBs: h2, hsqldb, mysql-connector-j, postgresql; spring-data-jdbc-core; springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui; jackson-databind-nullable; **MapStruct 1.6.3** (+ processor); jakarta.xml.bind-api; test: spring-boot-starter-test, webmvc-test, security-test, mockito-core, `woof_test` (OfficeFloor test), json-path, jackson.
- **Code generation**: `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` **7.23.0**, generatorName `spring`, library `spring-boot`, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, modelPackage `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, apiPackage `...rest.api`, `interfaceOnly=true`, `performBeanValidation=true`, `useSpringBoot3=true`, `useJakartaEe=true`, `serializationLibrary=jackson`. Generated sources added via build-helper from `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java`. MapStruct configured with `defaultComponentModel=spring`.

## 7. Package structure under src/main/java

Root package: `org.springframework.samples.petclinic`
- `config` — Spring/OfficeFloor configuration
- `model` — JPA entities (`Owner`, `Person`, `Pet`, etc.)
- `mapper` — MapStruct mappers (`OwnerMapper`, `PetMapper`, ...)
- `repository` — repositories, with subpackages `jdbc`, `jpa`, `springdatajpa`
- `security` — security setup
- `util` — helpers (`E164PhoneNumber`, `AgeBand`, `CityLocality`, `CustomerCode`, `LuhnCheckDigit`, ...)
- `rest`
  - `rest.function` — OfficeFloor step functions, one subpackage per resource: `owner`, `pet`, `vet`, `visit`, `pettype`, `specialty`, `user`, `common`, `root`. The `owner` subpackage holds the full owner pipeline (`BuildOwner`, `ApplyOwner`, `NormalizeOwnerTelephone`, `ValidateOwnerTelephoneLength`, `RespondWithOwner`, `SaveOwner`, `LoadOwner`, `ListOwners`, etc.).
  - `rest.escalation` — exception + handler pairs (incl. `InvalidTelephoneException(Handler)`, `TelephoneNationalNumberLengthException(Handler)`, `MissingOwnerFieldsException(Handler)`).
  - `rest.validation` — validation support.
  - `rest.dto` / `rest.api` — do not exist as source; generated at build time from `openapi.yml`.

Flow definitions and the API contract live under `src/main/resources/`: `openapi.yml` (the API/DTO contract) and `officefloor/rest/api/**` (per-endpoint YAML flows, e.g. `owners.POST.yml`, `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`) plus `officefloor/escalation/**`.

If the goal is to make `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay` pass, the field must be added in three coordinated places: (1) the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml` as a read-only `telephoneDisplay` property (so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field), (2) a derived getter on the `Owner` entity (like the existing derived getters `getLocality()`, `getContactPreference()`) — or a MapStruct expression in `OwnerMapper` — that formats the stored E.164 telephone as `+CC NNN NNN NNN`, and (3) the formatting logic itself (likely a new method in `E164PhoneNumber` or the util package).
